name: smstunnel
description: Send texts from your own Android phone and your own number: one recipient per text, your OK before anything is sent, delivery status, sign-in codes and replies.

api_key.title: SMSTunnel key
api_key.description: From dashboard.smstunnel.io: Apps, Add an app, MCP. It is kept in your system's secure storage.

default_country_code.title: Default country code
default_country_code.description: Optional, for example +40 or 1. It completes numbers written without +. Leave it empty to always use international numbers.
